caption: A reflective compact disc lies flat and centered on a pale, whitewashed wooden-plank surface with dark horizontal seams. The disc stays centered and appears stationary throughout, while the background lines remain visible. Soon, two hands enter from the bottom edge holding a short length of light-brown twine. The hands spread, stretch, and fold the twine in front of the lower part of the disc, working it between thumb and forefinger. The strand is bent into a loop near the lower edge of the disc. An index finger is worked through the loop while the hands pinch and draw the free end, tightening the twine around the finger. The twine changes from a loose strand to a looped form, but no lifting, threading, or completion is visible.
relations: The stationary centered disc remains in place as the background plank lines stay visible throughout.
Two hands entering from below bring a light-brown twine into view in front of the disc's lower edge.
Spreading and pinching the twine between thumb and forefinger bends it into a loop near the disc's lower rim.
Drawing the free end while an index finger passes through the loop tightens the strand into a looped form.
